scope: Fixed current models and records; seeds averaged within task; eight dependent-domain task means, not 24 independent tasks; no fits or historical-model reconstruction.

definitions.quantile_exact: kth smallest inclusive truth score, k=ceil((n+1)*0.9), one-based; infinity if k>n
definitions.order: descending probability, stable ties in saved class-column order
definitions.score: inclusive cumulative sum through candidate, clipped at 1
definitions.strict: candidate inclusive score <= threshold; empty sets allowed
definitions.unknown_labels: -1 outside model alphabet: always uncovered, even at infinite threshold
definitions.inversion_contrast: crossing minus strict at a fixed threshold
definitions.threshold_contrast: linear minus exact at a fixed inversion
definitions.interaction: (linear crossing-exact crossing)-(linear strict-exact strict); coverage columns are fractions; drop is percentage points
definitions.historical_caveat: The original supplied code used default reversed argsort ties and unclipped running sums; this factorial holds current tie/clipping conventions fixed.
